description: Find out if paying mortgage discount points is worth it — break-even months and net savings over your planned stay.

faqs.a: One discount point costs 1% of the loan amount, paid up front at closing, in exchange for a lower interest rate.
Break-even months = (points cost) ÷ (monthly payment savings). After that month, the lower payment puts you ahead.
If your break-even month comes after you plan to sell or refinance, points usually do not pay off. They work best for long stays.
faqs.q: When are points NOT worth it?

howto: Enter the loan amount, base rate and the points you are considering.
Enter the rate reduction each point buys and how many years you will stay.
Read the break-even month and your net savings.
title: Mortgage Points Calculator
